purpose: Matched E0/E1 test of the SD3-derived relative resolution shift on the existing downstream MiniMax H3 learned-refine pass. Continuum remains at its ordinary MP-driven base resolution; only the refine SIGMAS are remapped in E1.

model_chain.keep: existing DiffAid -> Untwist -> Spectrum -> H3RuntimeMetricsProbe -> H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4, followed by the existing MiniMax H3 Latent Upscaler + Refine (3D)

continuum.geometry: unchanged; existing MP width/height stay connected directly to Continuum width/height
continuum.sigmas: unchanged; do not insert H3ResolutionAwareSigmas into Continuum

target_geometry.purpose: Mirror only the downstream refine node's target-size calculation so the refine sigma map knows the true target canvas automatically.
target_geometry.placement: parallel metadata branch from the same MP width/height already used by Continuum; never feed helper outputs into Continuum

sigma_path.upstream_scheduler: existing refine scheduler SIGMAS; leave the scheduler and its widgets unchanged

insert.placement: between the existing refine scheduler SIGMAS output and MiniMax H3 Latent Upscaler + Refine (3D).sigmas

reference_basis.source_role: analytic H3-Base/native resolution regime; auto-derived from the downstream refine target aspect; no source-resolution pass is executed
reference_basis.official_basis: H3-Base is documented as 768p and H3 output shorter side defaults to 768 px
reference_basis.aspect_matching: source_width=source_height=0 invokes the pinned H3 native canvas rule: 768px short edge, 768*1344 area cap, per-axis round to 32. For the current 896x928 refine target this resolves to 768x800.

runs.invariant: Resolution-Aware Sigmas output must be bit-exact equal to the existing refine SIGMAS.

required_diagnostics.note: Numeric values are for the current 896x928 refine target; target geometry remains dynamic.

runs.only_intended_change_from_E0: refine sigma mode off -> resolution_aware and strength 0 -> 1

matched_invariants: refine sampler and base refine schedule

expected_structure.base_continuum: must be identical between E0 and E1 because the remap is downstream
expected_structure.total_logical_calls: record E0; do not reuse the earlier direct-target 38-call expectation
expected_structure.refine_actual_nfe_and_spectrum_forecasts: record rather than force parity; remapped refine coordinates may legitimately change Spectrum decisions
expected_structure.resolution_event: exactly one resolution_sigma_map event per graph execution
expected_structure.audio: with lock_audio=true the refine node restores sampler-1 audio after refinement; final audio should remain unchanged

metrics_probe.placement: after Spectrum and before Continuum; Continuum refine_state clones the sampled MODEL for the downstream refine pass
metrics_probe.purpose: passive model/sampler-call telemetry only; no capture, guidance, progressive, or attention behavior

output.metrics: connect to both H3ResolutionAwareSigmas.metrics and H3MetricsJSON.metrics; leave the probe's optional metrics input unconnected

decision_rule.before_decoding: Do not tune strength or calibrated_factor.
decision_rule.if_positive: Only then test the same refine-sigma remap with the accepted progressive+temporal path.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative: Leave resolution-aware sigmas experimental/off; do not start a strength sweep from this pair.
